The petro-morphs are shown completing a transformation into numerous spacecraft or battleships.
A very large swarm of ships fills the sky/space around the observers.
A seated woman at a gun or control position watches the swarm while two voices argue over the situation and violence.

visual_summary: A narration box explains that while two masters argued about making another pass over a castle, the remaining 'petro-morphs' changed shape. Small rounded machines are shown inside a structure, then a large exterior panel reveals many dark mechanical forms and smaller craft launching upward with bright engine trails. A caption states they transform into space battleships. In the final panel, a woman seated at a weapons station looks out over a dense swarm of ships while dialogue boxes argue about whether this is disaster or an excuse for killing.
